title: The Witness of Windrow House
author: Wendell Dunmore
blurb: Ivo Ishikawa, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
